info.title: Pseudalis interface
info.description: The local interface of Pseudalis, on this computer only (https://localhost:8444 by default). The files travel as they are, in the body of the requests. No account is needed; the operations of administration take the token of the data folder (%ProgramData%\Pseudalis\admin.token) in the X-Pseudalis-Admin header, which this page fills in by itself when the icon of Pseudalis opens it (Interface documentation), and which Authorize sets otherwise.

get.description: Product, edition ("Community"), version, engine (variant, models), fingerprint of the key, drive, Albireo and the number of originals kept.

post.description: Protects a document (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, text, CSV, markup), a picture or an archive (ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ) sent as the body, whose name gives the kind that its content must have. A file of any other extension, or without extension, is protected as a text when its content is text through and through: no binary signature, the measures of a text, every character decoded with no control character but the tabulation, the ends of lines and the form feed, and no encoded part: a block of base64, base64url or hexadecimal digits (1024 characters in a row, or 16 runs in a row of 60, the lines of a block, in a string of JSON or of a program too), data or JSON in base64, bytes in hexadecimal, a dump or an array (64 in a row, or 4 lines of 8, with letters or marks among them), a message with parts in base64, quoted-printable or uuencode or with encoded words, an RTF document, a vCard or an iCalendar, LDIF in base64, a block armored by PEM or OpenPGP, its header and its body, in a string too, uuencode or ASCII85, and, by its first line, a PostScript program or an export of the registry; without extension, a picture, an Office document, an archive or a PDF is also taken by its signature. A file of another kind, or whose content is not the kind its name gives, is refused (422, code unsupported or kind_mismatch), and so is a text of another extension that holds an encoded part (code encoded_content). Their content would come out half protected. A folder travels as a ZIP archive of its tree, which comes back anonymized. Each personal value becomes a tag [[TYPE:body#CCC]] encrypted under the key of this installation. A picture becomes the text file <name>.txt holding "[Image@<id> : <description>]", the description written by Albireo when it is installed, its values replaced by tags as those of the text of its document; the pictures of Word documents, slides and PDF pages are replaced in place the same way. The entries of an archive of another kind are left out, and listed in the report (dropped). The name of the file, the names of the entries and folders of an archive and the properties of the documents (title, authors, subject, keywords, company of Office documents, the document information of a PDF) take substitutes: each value written without its tag, whose tag the service records so that a restoration gives it back. The protected name is in X-Pseudalis-Name and in Content-Disposition. With record (the default), the original is kept, encrypted, so that /v1/restore gives it back from any copy of the protected file. A body larger than the route takes is refused before it is read (413): the files up to max_file_mb of the settings, the JSON bodies up to 16 MB. When every slot of work stays taken for a minute, the answer is 503 with Retry-After (code busy).

post.description: Gives back the original of a protected file: the original kept when the body is a protected file this installation recorded, or an entry of a protected archive that it recorded, extracted from that archive (X-Pseudalis-restored: original), the picture of a text file holding a picture marker (picture), else the file with the values of its tags put back (tags), and those of the substitutes of its name and of its properties that the service recorded. The original name is in X-Pseudalis-Name. A restoration reads the tags of a text under any name, and keeps the entries of an archive that it cannot read as they are, under their names restored. 404 when the file holds no value this key protected; 410 when the original of the file was forgotten (code original_forgotten) or kept for its time after the file left the drive (code original_expired), its date in args.date: such a file is not restored from its tags either. A body larger than the route takes is refused before it is read (413): the files up to max_file_mb of the settings, the JSON bodies up to 16 MB. When every slot of work stays taken for a minute, the answer is 503 with Retry-After (code busy).

delete.summary: Forget an original, and the pictures no other file shows
delete.description: Deletes the original of the record from the vault and remembers its protected file as forgotten, with the entries of a protected archive: their restoration is refused from then on, and the drive keeps such a file as it is when it comes back. A file extracted on the drive from a protected archive has a record and an original of its own, which this route forgets alone.

get.description: The address of the feed appears only when it differs from the one of the build.

put.description: The members given replace those of settings.json; the service restarts when the port, the letter of the drive, the date order, the proxy or the address of the feed change ("restart": true). The feed must be an https address, the proxy empty, "none" or http://host:port (400, code settings_publication otherwise). The changes apply in one step against concurrent ones.
